events.text: Bloomberg reports that Meta is considering a cloud service offering external customers computing capacity and AI models. The proposal could monetize capacity beyond its own requirements. Details remain under development.
The Associated Press has called Pennsylvania for Donald Trump. Counting and calls for other states continue; this bulletin does not announce the final national result.
The Associated Press has called Wisconsin for Donald Trump, taking him past the electoral vote threshold and declaring him the winner of the 2024 US presidential election.

V5 repairs synthetic quote precision and account presentation together; comparison with V4 is a bundled engineering diagnostic, not an isolated causal effect of each fix. Fixed sensitivity screen on the original short windows: three seeds, no liquidity, quarter-depth/budget, baseline, and fourfold-depth/budget. Spread/anchor unchanged.
